goal: Minimize first-token latency for the source's interactive workload (batch 1, prompt 256 tokens, full greedy generation of 32 new tokens), preserving the source model, inputs, completion semantics and full quality requirements.
notes: Command provenance (inputs/intent.json): python qwen_inference.py --assets /root/autodl-tmp/c3-qwen3-4b-operator-goals/assets/Qwen3-4B/1cfa9a7208912126459214e8b04321603b3df60c --output /tmp/original-qwen, run from the repository root; it uses the defaults --workloads workloads.json, --warmup 2, --repeats 5, no --profile.

workload is the verbatim 'interactive' row from workloads.json qwen_inference.workloads[0]; the row's second goal (decode_tokens_per_second) exists in source but this request optimizes only ttft_ms per the user goal; no source constraints are attached to this workload, so constraints stay empty.

Input construction (qwen_inference.py:55-58): chat template applied to workloads.json qwen_inference.prompt with add_generation_prompt=True and enable_thinking=False, encoded without special tokens, then token ids repeated/truncated to exactly prompt_tokens=256 and tiled to batch=1 on cuda. Generation length is fixed at new_tokens=32; EOS early stopping is disabled by the explicit loop.

Model/precision policy: Qwen3ForCausalLM.from_pretrained(assets, dtype=bfloat16, attn_implementation='sdpa', local_files_only=True).cuda().eval(); common.configure() sets matmul/cudnn TF32 off, float32 matmul precision 'highest', cudnn.benchmark False, seed 20261020, device 0.

ttft_ms is measured inside infer() (qwen_inference.py:16-24): perf_counter_ns around prefill forward + argmax terminated by torch.cuda.synchronize() ('explicit first-token-ready boundary'); decode is timed separately after that boundary. Per-repeat samples are reduced by median via common.summarize().

Discrete exact comparison: the full 32-step greedy token sequence must satisfy torch.equal(actual_tokens, tokens) (qwen_inference.py:62); logits are compared with torch.testing.assert_close at source tolerances (atol=rtol=0.02, source keys logits_atol/logits_rtol in workloads.json qwen_inference.correctness) against a teacher-forced reference captured with logits_to_keep=1 per step.

Reference construction, negative (+1 corruption) control, reference tensor saving, warmup/repeats loops and --profile tracing are the project's benchmark/quality harness, not the work repeated per invocation.
Single-process, single-GPU task (torch.cuda.set_device(0)); the machine's second RTX 4090 is not used, so device_count=1, no distributed backend, and no communication collector fields are required.

Model weights stay at the absolute asset path (revision directory 1cfa9a7208912126459214e8b04321603b3df60c, 3 safetensors shards plus tokenizer files; matches deployment.box42.example.json assets.qwen_inference); peak_allocated_bytes and decode metrics are recorded per sample by the source but are not objectives or constraints for this request.

One measured invocation: One clean infer(model, inputs, 32) call on the 'interactive' workload exactly as timed in qwen_inference.py main(): single forward prefill over the 256-token prompt (batch 1, use_cache=True, logits_to_keep=1), argmax of the last-position logits (greedy first token, explicit cuda-synchronize first-token-ready boundary), then the fixed loop of 31 cached decode steps to 32 new tokens, under torch.inference_mode() with the model already loaded BF16/SDPA on one GPU and inputs already resident on device. Excludes model loading and tokenization, reference construction (capture=True / teacher-forced runs), close_check/negative_check/torch.equal verification, torch.save of reference tensors, warmup, statistical repeats, summarize/report writing, and the optional --profile trace.
